note: Caixa Geral de Depósitos: the Conta Caixa S package (a current account, a debit card, free transfers) has a monthly maintenance fee of 5.46 euros, stamp duty included. Read again 2026-10-30: Conta Caixa S includes one debit card with no issue charge and free, unlimited transfers. Not stated on this page: overdraft, ATM fees, a share on another currency, interest, what opening asks.
